problem_text:
A logistics manager is planning the cargo loading for a specialized airship that will embark on a three-leg delivery route. The manager must select a collection of cargo containers to maximize total utility points while adhering to the vessel's strict total mass allowance.

The available containers are:
* Container A: mass 36 units, utility 117 credits
* Container B: mass 24 units, utility 245 credits
* Container C: mass 28 units, utility 126 credits
* Container D: mass 34 units, utility 75 credits
* Container E: mass 49 units, utility 102 credits
* Container F: mass 44 units, utility 256 credits
* Container G: mass 34 units, utility 83 credits
* Container H: mass 46 units, utility 20 credits
* Container I: mass 39 units, utility 30 credits
* Container J: mass 26 units, utility 77 credits
* Container K: mass 4 units, utility 113 credits
* Container L: mass 44 units, utility 205 credits
* Container M: mass 14 units, utility 254 credits
* Container N: mass 1 unit, utility 216 credits
* Container O: mass 34 units, utility 286 credits
* Container P: mass 8 units, utility 143 credits
* Container Q: mass 30 units, utility 35 credits
* Container R: mass 50 units, utility 171 credits
* Container S: mass 31 units, utility 37 credits
* Container T: mass 32 units, utility 80 credits
* Container U: mass 45 units, utility 79 credits
* Container V: mass 45 units, utility 190 credits
* Container W: mass 30 units, utility 177 credits
* Container X: mass 43 units, utility 41 credits
* Container Y: mass 6 units, utility 111 credits
* Container Z: mass 38 units, utility 10 credits
* Container AA: mass 6 units, utility 221 credits
* Container AB: mass 50 units, utility 149 credits
* Container AC: mass 14 units, utility 69 credits

An operational stipulation dictates that exactly one of Container A and Container B must be included in the shipment.

Furthermore, if Container C is selected, it imposes a special handling requirement that effectively diminishes the airship's usable mass capacity by 10 units.
The vessel's maximum allowable gross cargo mass is 619 units. The manager must determine the optimal set of containers to load.
